name: WeaselFoodTweaks
teaser: Bringing back the food and drink effects-over-time
description_html:
UPDATE: Please see Sneaky Weasel’s All-In-One Meds & Food for unified version with medical item changes. You can enable different parts of the mod in the config file, so just turn off med changes if you prefer!

Changes food and drink to make them less arcadey, for those like me who are missing Realism…

All items now deliver hydration/energy effects over time, rather than instantly.

Many also have multiple uses to reduce litter on the playfield.

Also see WeaselMedTweaks for similar over-time effects with medical items.
